verses.tl: Bismillaahir-Rahmaanir-Raheem
Hal ataa alal-insaani heenun minad-dahri lam yakun shay'an madhkooraa
Innaa khalaqnal-insaana min nutfatin amshaajin nabtaleehi faja'alnaahu samee'an baseeraa
Innaa hadaynaahus-sabeela immaa shaakiran wa immaa kafooraa
Innaa a'tadnaa lilkaafireena salaasilan wa aghlaalan wa sa'eeraa
Innal-abraara yashraboona min ka'sin kaana mizaajuhaa kaafooraa
Aynan yashrabu bihaa ibaadu Allaahi yufajjiroonahaa tafjeeraa
Yoofoona bin-nadhri wa yakhaafoona yawman kaana sharruhu mustateeraa
Wa yut'imoonat-ta'aama alaa hubbihi miskeenan wa yateeman wa aseeraa
Innamaa nut'imukum liwajhi Allaahi laa nureedu minkum jazaa'an wa laa shukooraa
Innaa nakhaafu min rabbinaa yawman aboosan qamtareeraa
Fawaqaahumu Allaahu sharra dhaalikal-yawmi wa laqqaahum nadratan wa surooraa
Wa jazaahum bimaa sabaroo jannatan wa hareeraa
Muttaki'eena feehaa alal-araa'iki laa yarawna feehaa shamsan wa laa zamhareeraa
Wa daaniyatan alayhim zilaaluhaa wa dhullilat qutoofuhaa tadhleelaa
Wa yutaafu alayhim bi-aaniyatin min fiddatin wa akwaabin kaanat qawaareer
Qawaareera min fiddatin qaddaroohaa taqdeeraa
Wa yusqawna feehaa ka'san kaana mizaajuhaa zanjabeelaa
Aynan feehaa tusammaa salsabeelaa
Wa yatoofu alayhim wildaanun mukhalladoona idhaa ra'aytahum hasibtahum lu'ulu'uan manthooraa
Wa idhaa ra'ayta thamma ra'ayta na'eeman wa mulkan kabeeraa
Aaliyahum thiyaabu sundusin khudrun wa istabraqun wa hulloo asaawira min fiddatin wa saqaahum rabbuhum sharaaban tahooraa
Inna haadhaa kaana lakum jazaa'an wa kaana sa'yukum mashkooraa
Innaa nahnu nazzalnaa alaykal-qur'aana tanzeelaa
Fasbir lihukmi rabbika wa laa tuti minhum aathiman aw kafooraa
Wadhkur isma rabbika bukratan wa aseelaa
Wa minal-layli fasjud lahu wa sabbihhu laylan taweelaa
Inna haa'ulaa'i yuhibboonal-aajilata wa yadharoona waraa'ahum yawman thaqeelaa
Nahnu khalaqnaahum wa shadadnaa asrahum wa idhaa shi'naa baddalnaa amthaalahum tabdeelaa
Inna haadhihi tadhkiratun faman shaa'a ittakhadha ilaa rabbihi sabeelaa
Wa maa tashaa'oona illaa an yashaa'a Allaahu innallaaha kaana aleeman hakeemaa
Yudkhilu man yashaa'u fee rahmatihi waz-zaalimeena a'adda lahum adhaaban aleemaa
